page.title: Surfaced elsewhere — a cross-reference index
page.subtitle: Documents from the DOJ Epstein release (EFTA) that came to attention because they were surfaced and circulated publicly — not located here through a search term or any statistical pass. Each row gives the primary file and its dataset, as a starting point to find the document in the release and read it directly. Any claim attached to a document elsewhere belongs to that source; what is stated here is only the document's type, date, and named parties as printed on the page.
page.explainer: A launch pad, not a finding. These are documents other people pointed at; this index records where each one sits in the files (bates id + dataset) and links the primary so it can be read in full and cross-referenced against the rest of the corpus going forward. Inclusion here is not endorsement of any reading placed on a document elsewhere. The link opens the page as released by the DOJ, redactions intact.
